title: Angie Bell Coker
clean_html:
Angie Bell Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-a5.htm

Angie Bell Coker was the daughter of Moses Coker and Mary Ann Dean . She was born in Kent Co., DE on 29 September, 1882. She married Andrew MOSLEY , the son of Joseph Mosley and Margaret Carney, sometime before 1884 and they had the following children: Sadie Mosley (1884-1908 or 11) Purnell Mosley ( d.1918) married Rebecca Raymond Mosley Mary E. Mosley (1910-1978), married William DRAINE (1894-1968) both are buried at John Wesley Church in Frederica DE Laura Mosley , married #1) Thomas Mosley and #2)Calvin Clark Nelson Mosley (1914-1969) married Elva Hansley children: James Mosley Gary Wayne Mosley Pearl Mosley married Gardiner Mosley, son of Frazier Mosley and Elsie Kimmey children: Preston Mosley Gardiner Mosley Kermit Mosley (1916-1983)married Elva Perry Calvin Mosley (1918- 1979) Oscar Mosley married Janet Street children: Oscar Mosley, Jr. Thomas James Mosley Sarah Mosley Harriett Mosley Joseph H. Mosley (b.c. 1919) Angie Bell died on 11 September, 1937 and was buried at John Wesley Cemetary in Kent Co., DE. Her husband, Andrew Mosley, called one of the last of the Kent Co. splint basketmakers, died in 1944. One of his baskets was collected by C. A. Weslager and turned over to the Heye Foundation Museum in New York.
